import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
PRIVATE = ROOT / ".claude/private-reviews/hs0002-20260910"
PRIVATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
os.chmod(PRIVATE, 0o700)
session = str(uuid.uuid4())
command = ["env", "-u", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "claude", "-p", "--safe-mode",
           "--permission-mode", "dontAsk", "--tools", "Bash,Read,Glob,Grep",
           "--allowedTools", "Bash,Read,Glob,Grep", "--output-format", "stream-json",
           "--verbose", "--session-id", session]
manifest = json.loads((OUT / "final-candidate-files.json").read_text())
files = manifest["files"]
before = {f: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
record = {"command": command, "cwd": str(ROOT), "session": session,
          "started": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
          "prompt": "v1-final-prompt.txt", "prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256((OUT / "v1-final-prompt.txt").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "files_before": before}
(OUT / "v1-final-cli-running.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
raw = PRIVATE / "v1-final-cli-original.jsonl"
fd = os.open(raw, os.O_CREAT | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
start = time.monotonic()
with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream, (OUT / "v1-final-prompt.txt").open("rb") as prompt:
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=prompt, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record.update({"ended": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               "elapsed": time.monotonic() - start, "exit_code": result.returncode,
               "raw_original": str(raw.relative_to(ROOT)),
               "raw_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "raw_bytes": raw.stat().st_size,
               "files_after": {f: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}})
(OUT / "v1-final-cli.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
